scope: source map and Phoenix consumer boundary for the Sally shared combat-entry sequence, attack selector, terrain, and reached navtest decorator

tasks.sourceBehavior: ReceiveExecuteAI checks for BPI_CombatGameMode; if available it reads connected-player count, obtains the pawn staggerable_bpc_C, resolves UnscaledArmorAmount and ArmorDuration via SimplifiedBBData_GetFloat, calls AddStaggerArmor, and finishes true. If the game-mode interface is missing, it finishes true only if the staggerable component exists; otherwise false.
tasks.sharedComponentEvidence: AddStaggerArmor allocates a GUID and inserts a local stagger_armor_data record at index 0. staggerable_bpc_C declares Debug1HitStagger as a BoolProperty, but the CDO omits it (false). Sally amount=0 and duration=10 therefore yield RemainingAmount=0, InitialArmorAmount=0, DegenRate=0. StaggerArmorStack is not replicated.
tasks.phoenixStatus: implemented for the exported Sally zero-amount case: records the local GUID stack entry; there is no combat armor effect and no wire replication because StaggerArmorStack is non-net.

tasks.sourceBehavior: Requires a valid ai_coordination_agent_bpc_C MainGroupID to submit a message to the group manager; resolves optional PayloadActorBBKey, sets INTERNAL_SourceAgent, then calls PushMessageToGroup and finishes true. If MainGroupID is invalid, it finishes true when FailIfNotInAGroup is false, otherwise false (with assertion path).
tasks.singleBehemothImplication: With FailIfNotInA Group false, an invalid MainGroupID completes successfully by design. Phoenix has no coordination manager or group-ID assignment, so it follows the source success path for this solo composition; actual group-message delivery is outside this consumer.
tasks.phoenixStatus: implemented for solo AllOtherAgents flow with the source false default; it does not validate MainGroupID or deliver through an AI group manager

classDefaultInterpretation.basis: own Blueprint BoolProperty; CDO omits the field, so its zero/default value is false

tasks.sourceBehavior: PerformConditionCheckAI gets behemoth scale (or actor scale if interface unavailable), scales each Displacement, calls PathHitsNavMesh with NavigationQueryFilter_NoDynamic and QueryExtent (100,100,1024), then returns the negated result.
tasks.phoenixStatus: implemented approximate sampled segment coverage and Detour polygon connectivity over recovered Behemoth geometry; exact native query parity unverified
